review.title: Portfolio review
review.insightsHint: Rules applied to your own figures. Deterministic, and never advice.
review.benchmarkHint: Your time-weighted return against an index over the same period.
review.riskHint: Measured on flow-adjusted returns. A metric with too little data says so.
review.concentrationHint: How weight is spread across positions.
review.sectorHint: From your market-data provider. Never inferred from a symbol.
review.noSectorMetadata: N/A — your provider has no sector metadata for these holdings.
review.goalsHint: Progress derived from the same figures as the dashboard.
review.thesesHint: Your reasoning, with the status you set — never one Stockly decided.
review.noTheses: No open theses. Write one from a position page.

insights.empty: Nothing to flag. Insights appear as a portfolio accumulates positions and history.
